title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
titleZh: Reflexion：通过语言反馈改进智能体
summaryZh: 让智能体把任务反馈写成反思文本，保存在记忆中，并用于下一次尝试。无需更新模型权重，探索从试错中改进决策的路径。
summaryEn: Agents turn task feedback into reflective text, retain it in episodic memory, and use it in subsequent attempts without updating model weights.

notes.textZh: 语言智能体如何在不进行昂贵微调的情况下，从任务失败和外部反馈中学习？
notes.textEn: How can language agents learn from failures and feedback without costly fine-tuning?

notes.textZh: 将标量或文字形式的反馈转化为语言反思，存入情节记忆，并在后续尝试中作为上下文使用。
notes.textEn: Convert scalar or textual feedback into verbal reflections, store them in episodic memory, and reuse them as context in later trials.

notes.textZh: 论文摘要报告了序列决策、编程和语言推理任务上的改进。具体实验设置、基线与消融请参阅原文；此处不将结果外推至科学发现任务。
notes.textEn: The abstract reports improvements on sequential decision-making, coding, and language reasoning. Consult the paper for setups, baselines, and ablations; this summary does not generalize the results to scientific discovery.

notes.textZh: 用于 AI4S 时，仍需验证反馈是否可靠、任务能否重复执行，以及反思内容是否有效。
notes.textEn: For AI4S use, evaluate feedback reliability, repeatability, and reflection quality.

classificationReason: 这篇研究不限定具体学科的通用智能体方法，因此归入通用 AI；智能体和推理作为方法标签。

notesMeta.basisEn: Existing summary; full paper not checked.
